action_summary: Kept the v54 DeBERTa-large inference pipeline but changed three things in predict_exp302.py and its CLI call. (1) Thresholds: if pred_df_fold*.csv out-of-fold files exist next to the config, OptimizedRounder is fitted on the concatenated OOF raw_pred/score from several initialisations, averaged, and blended 50/50 with the CLI weights; otherwise the CLI weights are used (a --no-oof-fit flag disables this). This replaces hand-tuned thresholds, which history shows can swing the score by ~0.009 alone. (2) Ensemble: added the v52 single-fold checkpoint (exp301-1-large-itpt10-f0/model_fold0_last.pth), the best-scoring model in the history, to the four 'all' fold checkpoints; missing checkpoint paths are skipped so the pipeline cannot break. (3) Fallback thresholds moved back toward earlier OOF-fitted values ([1.64, 2.55, 3.43, 4.40, 5.14]), especially restoring the 3/4 boundary that v54 had pushed down to 3.357.
